name: dexter-desk-desktop
description: Isolated macOS desktop companion host for Dexter: floating overlay, optional local AI and speech, sharing the browser behavior engine

scripts.check: node --check main.cjs && node --check smoke.cjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check preload-ui.cjs && node --check renderer.js && node --check hit-test.js && node --check speech-queue.js && node --check window-state.cjs && node --check ui/chat.js && node --check ui/settings.js && node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('core')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'core/' + f], {stdio: 'inherit'})" && npm test && npm run prepare
